verdict.rationale: Capacities documents linking between objects and blocks, a dedicated "Backlinks" section at the bottom of each object, and a graph view of how notes connect, so the core linking and backlink experience is covered. The evidence never mentions the [[wiki-style]] bracket syntax, never shows an unlinked-mentions feature, and does not say backlinks are shown with surrounding context; the daily-note "mentions" item covers dates only. Missing for 10: evidence of [[ ]] link syntax, unlinked mention detection, in-context backlink snippets, independent hands-on corroboration.
